page_note: 世界贸易报告2024第32页：两栏正文加页底一幅带蓝色标题横幅的双轴复合图（柱+折线）Figure B.1，下附Source与Note小字。

heading.title: Positive correlation between low- and middle-income economies' convergence speed and trade participation, 1996-2021

figures.source_line: Source: Authors' calculations, based on World Bank data on nominal GDP and real GDP per capita and WTO data on trade in goods and commercial services.

components.evidence: left axis 'Speed of income convergence (percentage points)', right axis 'Trade participation (100=1996)'
blue bars per year with a green line crossing the same plot area
2009 bar dark blue to ~3.8 then light blue continuing to ~7.7; 2020 bar likewise two-tone
left axis lowest tick '-1'; the 2021 bar hangs just below the zero line
Note: 'The light blue fill indicates a contribution of negative growth in high-income economies.'
'(percentage points)' in left axis title; bare numbers -1..8 on the axis itself
both axis titles set vertically along the left and right axes
year labels 1996...2021 tilted about 45 degrees under the axis
'Speed of income convergence' and 'Trade participation' swatches centred under the plot
'Source: Authors' calculations...' and 'Note: The figure displays the evolution over time...' below the figure
faint horizontal rules at each left-axis tick, no vertical rules
2009 and 2020 bar portions drawn in pale blue against the dark blue of all other years
body text 'global poverty rate¹' and '(Cerdeiro and Komaromi, 2021).²'

new_components.name: banner_title_block
new_components.evidence: figure number and title set in white on a solid blue band spanning the plot width
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题在色块横幅内而非普通文字行，解析器可能丢掉标题或把它并入表格外，取值时无法定位图号。

new_components.name: legend_omits_extra_color
new_components.evidence: pale blue bar fill has no legend entry; only the Note explains it
new_components.why_it_matters: 7.7与2.2这类含浅蓝段的柱子无法从图例得到名称，行标签只能引用Note文字。

new_components.name: zero_valued_bar_absent
new_components.evidence: no bar drawn at 1998 between the 1997 and 1999 bars
new_components.why_it_matters: 0.0这一年在图上没有可测标记，只能靠空槽推断，表格里必须显式写出该年为0。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签（values_printed=none），全部要靠像素对轴读数。左轴刻度间距1个百分点约占30px，2.7的5%容差仅±0.135，即约4px；-0.2与0.0的5%容差是±0.01和0，物理上不可达。右轴刻度每20个指数点（40,60,...,160）约占48px，128的容差±6.4只有约15px，而折线26个点、无标记点，2012与2011峰值相差仅约4px，极易错点。相比之下行标签只需‘系列名+年份’两个键，标题也是清晰横幅，所以卡点在读数精度。
